svg.title: Atomic-layer deposition reactor, precursor A pulse
svg.desc: Cutaway of a cross-flow ALD reactor during the first half-reaction: the valve of precursor line A is open and line B closed; precursor molecules cross the wafer from the inlet to the exhaust and a chemisorbed layer covers the wafer surface.
